growth_expectations.rationale: Activity increased modestly; ten Districts reported slight to moderate growth.

inflation_concern.rationale: Prices increased moderately; elevated energy, transportation, raw material cost pressures.

labor_market.rationale: Employment rose very slightly; healthy demand in manufacturing and construction.

credit_conditions.rationale: Financial conditions improved slightly; loan volumes remained solid or increased.

policy_uncertainty.rationale: Heightened uncertainty surrounding energy prices, policy, and international conflict effects.
